copy.name: Angel drill (copy)

steps.note: A1 runs diagonally across to a spot about 5 m in front of line B. B1 throws straight ahead to meet the cut. Line A steps up.
steps.title: Diagonal cut, straight throw

steps.note: Right after the throw, B1 runs diagonally toward the other side. A1 passes across the field to B1. Line B steps up.
steps.title: Thrower cuts, horizontal pass

steps.note: B1 gives the disc back to the front of line A, then jogs to the back of line A. A1 jogs to the back of line B.
steps.title: Return to the line

steps.note: Same pattern the other way. B2 cuts diagonally to about 5 m in front of line A, and A2 throws straight to them.
steps.title: Reverse: diagonal cut

steps.note: A2 cuts diagonally toward line B’s side and B2 passes across to them.
steps.title: Reverse: horizontal pass

steps.note: A2 gives the disc back to the front of line B and joins the back of line B. B2 joins the back of line A. The next pair starts again from line B.
steps.title: Reverse: return

copy.summary: Two lines facing the end zone. A diagonal cut takes a straight throw in front of the other line, the thrower cuts across for a horizontal pass, then gives the disc back to the line. Repeats in the other direction with the next pair.

copy.name: Box drill (copy)

steps.note: B jabs out, then cuts in toward the box. A throws to the cut and follows the throw to B’s cone. Next in line steps up at A.
steps.title: A to B

steps.note: Same move from the next corner. Cut in, catch, throw on, follow.
steps.title: B to C

steps.note: Keep the cuts sharp: sell the jab outward so the in-cut creates separation.
steps.title: C to D

steps.note: Lap complete. Switch direction every few minutes so everyone practises both flick and backhand.
steps.title: D to A

copy.summary: Four cones in a 20 m square. The disc goes around the box: cut in from the next cone, catch, throw on, follow your throw.

copy.name: Dump & swing off the sideline (copy)

steps.note: H1 is trapped. H2 fakes upfield, then cuts back behind the disc for an easy dump. The stall count resets.
steps.title: Dump behind the mark

steps.note: H3 comes across to take the swing while H1 cuts upfield after the dump (give-and-go). The disc is now central and the whole field is open.
steps.title: Swing to the middle

steps.note: With the field reset, cutter 1 attacks from the front of the stack into the new open side.
steps.title: Hit the cutter

copy.summary: The disc is trapped on the sideline. A dump behind the mark and a swing to the middle reset the stall and flip the open side.

copy.name: Go-to drill (copy)

steps.note: First cutter jabs upfield, plants, and breaks in toward open space. The thrower leads the cut.
steps.title: Jab, then cut

steps.note: Cutter returns the disc to the next thrower, then jogs to the back of the thrower line. The thrower runs to the back of the cutter line; both lines step up.
steps.title: Return and rotate

steps.note: Same pattern for the next pair. Throw, follow to the cutter line, cut, return the disc, join the thrower line.
steps.title: Next rep

copy.summary: Two lines, one disc per rep. Cut, catch, return the disc, rotate. Good warm-up for timing between thrower and cutter.

copy.name: Horizontal stack: under, deep, continue (copy)

steps.note: Cutter 2 sells deep, then cuts under into the space between handlers and cutters. H1 hits the cut early.
steps.title: Under cut into the lane

steps.note: Cutter 3 attacks the space 2 just left. 1 and 4 widen to keep the lane open. 2 turns and puts it deep before the defense recovers.
steps.title: Deep strike behind

steps.note: 4 keeps running the far lane. A short continuation throw finishes the point.
steps.title: Continuation to the end zone

copy.summary: Three handlers across the field, four cutters flat. An under cut opens a deep lane for the next cutter.

copy.name: Vertical stack: under & deep (copy)

steps.note: Cutter 1 jabs deep for two steps, plants, and cuts back toward the disc into the open side. H1 leads the cutter with a flick to space.
steps.title: Under cut from the front

steps.note: As soon as 1 turns upfield, 5 at the back of the stack attacks the deep open-side lane. H2 moves up as the reset; 1 puts it deep.
steps.title: Deep cut from the back

steps.note: The rest of the stack holds the lane clear until the huck is up, then crashes toward the end zone for a second look.
steps.title: Score, then crash

copy.summary: Front of the stack cuts under to the open side, back of the stack goes deep into the space the stack kept clear.
